x: Frost proved the strongest throughout to finish in 2.13.8. D. Mitchell ran well in his first youth's race and improved on his placing in the Boys' event last year.
The High Jump was held on 4th July and the winner of the boys' section was D.Groves with 4 ft. 5ins. plus an allowance of 2ins. Of the four youths, D. Mitchell was again winner with 4 ft. 7ins.
Brazier won the Junior 440 yards in 54.9s. with D.
